name: render_poppler_material
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,base64
p=Path.cwd()
for src,page,name in [('matching.pdf',2,'original-p2'),('matching-comparison.pdf',2,'slides-p2'),('matching-comparison.pdf',5,'slides-p5')]:
 z=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(page),'-l',str(page),'-singlefile','-scale-to','1600','-png',str(p/'inputs/author/sources'/src)],capture_output=True,timeout=25);assert z.returncode==0,z.stderr
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'visuals/'+name+'.png','--base64'],input=base64.b64encode(z.stdout).decode(),text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr;print(r.stdout)
